name: CustomerActivity
description: Per customer: how many Priority documents the app holds, the latest one and the active debt
technicalDescription: Invoices grouped by customerCode: document count, latest invoiceDate, and the active debt = sum of amount over documents with no IVRECONDATE (open = not reconciled in Priority; credit notes are negative so unreconciled credits reduce it). Partial payments are not visible from the source.

select.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN i.reconciledDate IS NULL AND COALESCE(i.deletedInSource, false) = false THEN COALESCE(i.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END)
SUM(CASE WHEN i.reconciledDate IS NULL AND COALESCE(i.deletedInSource, false) = false AND COALESCE(i.amount,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

calculatedColumns.name: openDebt
calculatedColumns.description: Active debt ILS: sum of amount of documents with no Priority reconciliation (credit notes negative)
